Both parts landed.
(1) Analysis, 86b71d3: template v13 is now the latest. Its src/validate_tasks.py makes a scientific task's call and hands the named output field to the skill's named input, with each other input taken from its row in envelope/parameters.json. It runs the skill through src/run_skill.py and judges the skill's named output against the reference, stated or by function, with the skill's run kept on the result. A row that is absent or null leaves the task not_run ('the row X ... has no value yet'); a skill refused by its runner is not_run, a failed one is fail. A task without an analysis is judged as before. The Designer already carries analysis into validation/scientific/ unchanged. Before anything is written, the build refuses an analysis whose skill the bundle does not carry, whose output the skill does not give, whose field the call does not return, or with an input no row hands; the intake stage judges the same, and the check is shared with decisions (bundle.handed_problems). Tested in test_template_v13 on an engine (lattice count through box_length_for_volume_fraction) and a spectrometer (temperatures through series_within_window's mean). With the mechanisms taken out, 6 of 6 fail.
(2) Estimate binding, 81ff7b6: landed from clone commit d9d3f98 (run 20261117-3), read from that path only. The patch applied clean to bounds.py and designer.bound_skills. Applicability still lists bound skills only, so an estimate is used where a binding names it and never required. Added to its six tests: two real estimates of unrelated kinds through the skill runner, a box per particle count and an acquisition time per target signal-to-noise (scans_for_signal_to_noise@v1 from contracts/examples), each row per point with basis.output. Against the old bounds.apply, 8 of 8 fail or error.
meta_agent/tests 301 OK, contracts/tests 116 OK.
